question: Which of the following is an example of an operating system commonly used on laptops?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Windows 11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Windows 11** is the latest operating system developed by Microsoft, specifically designed to optimize performance and user experience on laptops and PCs.
 
• It was officially released on **October 5, 2021**, as the successor to Windows 10.
 
• The operating system features a redesigned user interface, including a centered Start menu, updated taskbar, and new window management tools like Snap Layouts.
 
• Windows 11 supports enhanced security features such as **Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, and Windows Hello** for biometric authentication.
 
• It is compatible with most modern laptops and desktops, provided they meet specific hardware requirements, such as a minimum of 4GB RAM and 64GB storage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operating System (OS):**

 
 
• An OS is software that acts as an intermediary between hardware and the user, managing system resources and facilitating program execution.
 
• Common types of operating systems include Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
 
• Operating systems handle tasks such as memory management, file systems, process scheduling, and security.
 
 
 
• **Microsoft Corporation:**
 
 
• Microsoft is an American multinational technology company founded by **Bill Gates** and **Paul Allen** in **1975**.
 
• It is one of the largest software companies globally and is known for its Windows operating system and Office suite.
 
• Microsoft has expanded into hardware, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence sectors over the years.
 
 
 
• **Other Examples of Operating Systems:**
 
 
• **macOS:** Developed by Apple Inc., specifically for Mac computers.
 
• **Linux:** Open-source operating system widely used for servers, desktops, and embedded systems.
 
• **Chrome OS:** A lightweight OS developed by Google, designed for Chromebooks and focused on web-based applications.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Windows 11:**
 
 
• **Virtual Desktops:** Allows users to create multiple desktops for different tasks.
 
• **DirectStorage:** Optimized for gaming, enabling faster load times and improved graphics performance.
 
• **Microsoft Teams Integration:** Built directly into the OS for seamless communication.
 
• **Widgets:** Provides quick access to news, weather, and personalized updates.
 
• **Enhanced Touch, Pen, and Voice Support:** Designed for hybrid devices and improved accessibility.
